notes: RMIT publishes its own 'Genuine Student Requirement Statement of Purpose' PDF with distinct sections/instructions, not the DHA-generic category set. Source PDF should be re-fetched and diffed periodically — confirm no 2026 revision.
action_needed: Resolved: RMIT Genuine Student SOP structure harvested from official RMIT template 2026-07-16

structure.instruction: Briefly describe your personal and family background. Declare if you have any family members living in Australia, their relationship to you, and their visa type.

Provide details of your spouse and children if applicable, including spouse's highest qualification and occupation, whether they accompany you, and your awareness of dependents' visa costs and conditions.
Explain your choice of program, your research/knowledge of course and tuition costs, and provide a clear justification if changing career path from your previous studies.
Explain any gaps in your education or employment history, and detail your prior immigration history including visa grants or refusals for Australia or other countries.
Justify why you chose to study in Australia over your home country, and detail your institutional research explaining why you selected RMIT University specifically.
Outline your long-term career objectives, post-study plans, and expected salary/promotion benefits in your home country upon completing this RMIT qualification.
